reuse.why: Changes the existing getScheduledAmount that every server and client call site already uses, and routes the last inline midpoint copy in schedule-template through it.

duplication.why: Removes the remaining inline midpoint copy; schedule-template still keeps its own op === 'isbetween' ternary around the helper, a small redundant dispatch.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, the tree's single definition of a schedule's expected amount.

scope.why: A minimal edit to the helper, its doc comment and the one stray call site.

maintainability.why: The rule is defined once and documented, so future changes touch a single function.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; schedule-template now calls getScheduledAmount, though it keeps an outer isbetween check

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount, used by forecast, schedules/app.ts, preview, schedule-template and the desktop client
